title: Fix inconsistent admin wallet recognition message in Dashboard

requirements.text: Fix the Dashboard UI so it never shows an admin wallet balance while simultaneously showing an admin-recognition error (e.g., “Not recognized as admin”). The admin wallet status (loading / not logged in / not an admin / error / success) must be derived consistently from the same data source and rendered in only one coherent state at a time.

quotes: Udhar admin wallet show ho gaya g lakin ya likha aya raha h k admin wallet not recognize why?

acceptanceCriteria: When the admin wallet balance renders as a number, the UI does not render any 'not recognized as admin'/'unauthorized' messaging anywhere on the Dashboard for the same session.
When the caller is not an admin, the Dashboard shows only the 'not an admin' messaging and does not show an admin wallet balance.
When the admin wallet balance request fails for reasons other than authorization, the Dashboard shows an error state (not the 'not an admin' state).
All user-facing status strings remain in English.

requirements.text: Update admin gating logic on the Dashboard so admin-only actions (e.g., “Distribute Funds to User”) are shown based on a single canonical admin signal that cannot disagree with the displayed admin wallet balance (e.g., treat a successful admin wallet balance fetch as sufficient proof of admin access, and treat a null/unauthorized response as non-admin).
acceptanceCriteria: If the admin wallet balance is successfully fetched (non-null), the “Distribute Funds to User” card is available on the Dashboard.
If the admin wallet balance is null due to authorization, the “Distribute Funds to User” card is not shown.
There is no state where admin-only actions are hidden while an admin wallet balance is displayed.

requirements.text: Harden the admin wallet balance query error handling so unauthorized/non-admin is not falsely inferred from non-auth errors. Ensure only true authorization failures result in a null admin wallet balance; other failures must surface as an error state to the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-auth backend failure (e.g., temporary actor/connection issue) results in an error state in the Dashboard admin wallet UI, not a 'Not recognized as admin' state.
A true backend authorization failure results in a 'not an admin/unauthorized' UI state and a null admin wallet balance in React Query data.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if a state upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Do not add new authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Do not redesign unrelated pages or add new product features beyond fixing the admin recognition/status mismatch.
